fit_reason: Whole 2013 Chaparral Sunesta 264 deck boat on trailer, listed by a private seller.
findings: Hull and gelcoat along the starboard side look glossy with no visible chalking or oxidation
Light grime and slight discoloration on the cream vinyl of the rear sun pad and bench cushions
Minor scuffing and soiling on the cockpit floor near the floor hatch
Some dirt in the seams and piping of the aft lounge cushions
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Chaparral Sunesta 264 and it looks well kept. The cream vinyl on the rear sun pad and lounge cushions shows a bit of grime in the seams, and the cockpit floor has some light scuffing. We do mobile pre-sale details that include a vinyl cleaning and a wash and wax, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
